---
title: "OrPen SC PDK"
description: "Public superconducting quantum and RF PDK documentation."
---

`orpen-sc-pdk` provides public superconducting quantum/RF layout cells, CPW
cross-sections, process layers, materials and semantic source geometry for
GDSFactory. Install the package in your own project; keep private chip designs,
parameters and run evidence in that project.

Build reusable cells with GDSFactory, inspect their settings and tags, and
compose layouts using OrPen's CPW cross-sections, layers and material records.
The base M1 film defaults to 100 nm; airbridge and bump levels retain their
separately declared dimensions. Choose parameters and materials appropriate
to your own design rather than treating examples as
measured process specifications.

Simulation is optional. The public notebooks pass source layouts and semantic
intent to SCGSim for native geometry, meshes, solver handoff, result resolution
and reporting. Choose the version-bound example that matches your runtime.

## Choose a task

- [Get Started](getting-started.md): install, activate OrPen and build a cell.
- [Cells](public-pdk-examples/index.md): choose factories, source test-layout
  families, tags or the inline component layout gallery.
- [Process](materials-and-technology.md): layers, stack, materials, interface
  presets and the source/runtime ownership boundary.
- [Simulation](notebooks.qmd): choose a version-bound public SCGSim example;
  distinguish revised source candidates from retained execution evidence.
- [API](reference/index.qmd): package, cell and material interfaces.

Source availability is not native mesh/contact/solver proof. The public source
test layouts and newer runtime examples retain their stated limitations.
